whyTitle: Why selling to Toronto needs outbound

why.title: Canada's financial and tech hub
why.desc: Bay Street's banks and insurers sit alongside a large AI and SaaS scene around MaRS and King West. Both buy from suppliers worldwide and filter hard.

why.title: CASL is strict
why.desc: Canada's anti-spam law is one of the strictest. Outreach has to rely on proper consent, such as a business address published for the role you're writing about, or it shouldn't be sent.

why.title: A natural market for Indian firms
why.desc: Indian IT, outsourcing and services companies already serve Canadian clients. A direct outbound channel adds clients beyond partners and referrals.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) requires consent. Implied consent can apply when a business address is conspicuously published, with no statement refusing messages, and the email relates to the person's role. Every email needs sender details and an unsubscribe. Read our [cold email compliance guide](/resources/blogs/cold-email-compliance-guide). Comparing agencies?
